table.sql: SELECT order_id, amount FROM fct_orders ORDER BY ctid;

rows.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders
FROM fct_orders;

test.sql:
-- What a dbt 'unique' test on order_id checks: return duplicate keys
SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM fct_orders
GROUP BY order_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY order_id;

revenue.sql:
SELECT SUM(amount) AS every_row,
  (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT order_id, amount FROM fct_orders) d) AS one_per_order,
  SUM(amount) - (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT order_id, amount FROM fct_orders) d) AS too_high
FROM fct_orders;

after.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows FROM fct_orders;

table.sql: SELECT order_id, status, customer_id, amount FROM fct_orders ORDER BY ctid;

dim.sql: SELECT customer_id, name FROM dim_customer ORDER BY customer_id;

unique.sql:
SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM fct_orders
GROUP BY order_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

acceptedValues.sql:
SELECT *
FROM fct_orders
WHERE status NOT IN
  ('placed', 'shipped', 'delivered', 'cancelled');

relationships.sql:
SELECT o.*
FROM fct_orders o
LEFT JOIN dim_customer c
  ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.customer_id IS NOT NULL
  AND c.customer_id IS NULL;

builtins.yaml:
# models/schema.yml
models:
  - name: fct_orders
    columns:
      - name: order_id
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: status
        data_tests:
          - accepted_values:
              arguments:
                values: ['placed', 'shipped', 'delivered', 'cancelled']
      - name: customer_id
        data_tests:
          - relationships:
              arguments:
                to: ref('dim_customer')
                field: customer_id
builtins.singularFile:

FROM {{ ref('fct_orders') }}
WHERE amount < 0

table.sql: SELECT order_id, line_number, sku FROM fct_order_lines ORDER BY ctid;

orderOnly.sql:

FROM fct_order_lines
GROUP BY order_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY order_id;

pair.sql:
SELECT order_id, line_number, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM fct_order_lines
GROUP BY order_id, line_number

compound.yaml:
- name: fct_order_lines
  data_tests:
    - dbt_utils.unique_combination_of_columns:

          combination_of_columns: [order_id, line_number]

newest.sql: SELECT MAX(_loaded_at) AS newest FROM raw_orders;

checks.sql:
SELECT c.checked_at,
  c.checked_at - MAX(r._loaded_at) AS age,
  CASE
    WHEN c.checked_at - MAX(r._loaded_at) > INTERVAL '12 hours' THEN 'error'
    WHEN c.checked_at - MAX(r._loaded_at) > INTERVAL '6 hours' THEN 'warn'
    ELSE 'pass'
  END AS freshness
FROM raw_orders r
CROSS JOIN (VALUES (TIMESTAMP '2026-03-02 04:00'), (TIMESTAMP '2026-03-02 09:00'), (TIMESTAMP '2026-03-02 14:00')) AS c(checked_at)
GROUP BY c.checked_at
ORDER BY c.checked_at;

unique.sql: SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM raw_orders GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

notNull.sql: SELECT * FROM raw_orders WHERE order_id IS NULL;

acceptedValues.sql: SELECT * FROM raw_orders WHERE status NOT IN ('placed', 'shipped', 'delivered', 'cancelled');

relationships.sql: SELECT r.* FROM raw_orders r LEFT JOIN dim_customer c ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id WHERE r.customer_id IS NOT NULL AND c.customer_id IS NULL;

freshness.yaml:
sources:
  - name: raw
    tables:
      - name: orders
        config:
          loaded_at_field: _loaded_at
          freshness:
            warn_after: {count: 6, period: hour}
            error_after: {count: 12, period: hour}

ci.command:
# Slim CI: build + test only what changed and its children
dbt build --select state:modified+ --state ./prod-artifacts

volume.sql:
SELECT load_date, COUNT(*) AS rows
FROM fct_orders
GROUP BY load_date
ORDER BY load_date;

unique.sql:
SELECT d.load_date, COUNT(t.load_date) AS failing
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT load_date FROM fct_orders) d
LEFT JOIN (SELECT load_date, order_id FROM fct_orders GROUP BY load_date, order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) t ON t.load_date = d.load_date
GROUP BY d.load_date
ORDER BY d.load_date;

notNull.sql:
SELECT d.load_date, COUNT(t.load_date) AS failing
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT load_date FROM fct_orders) d
LEFT JOIN (SELECT load_date FROM fct_orders WHERE order_id IS NULL) t ON t.load_date = d.load_date
GROUP BY d.load_date
ORDER BY d.load_date;

acceptedValues.sql:
SELECT d.load_date, COUNT(t.load_date) AS failing
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT load_date FROM fct_orders) d
LEFT JOIN (SELECT load_date FROM fct_orders WHERE status NOT IN ('placed', 'shipped', 'delivered', 'cancelled')) t ON t.load_date = d.load_date
GROUP BY d.load_date
ORDER BY d.load_date;

relationships.sql:
SELECT d.load_date, COUNT(t.load_date) AS failing
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT load_date FROM fct_orders) d
LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.load_date FROM fct_orders o LEFT JOIN dim_customer c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.customer_id IS NOT NULL AND c.customer_id IS NULL) t ON t.load_date = d.load_date
GROUP BY d.load_date
ORDER BY d.load_date;

reconcile.sql:
SELECT d.day, d.revenue, f.revenue AS finance
FROM daily_revenue d
JOIN finance_daily f ON f.day = d.day
WHERE ABS(d.revenue - f.revenue) > 0.01 * f.revenue;

FROM orders o
JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY o.order_date;
